sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Anurag Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2.
The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.46 of 2024, under Section 498A, 304B, 323 IPC & Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Naimisharyan, District Sitapur.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant argues that mother-in-law was enlarged on bail vide order dated 04.07.2024 and the present applicant is brother-in-law.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering and adopting the reasoning as contained in the order dated 04.07.2024 coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
5. Considering and adopting the reasoning as contained in the order dated 04.07.2024 coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
Let the applicant Vijay be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
